Equipment:

Introduction
This document out line the equipment inspection I1, when must be carried out 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the 
 title block.
Technical Data
Voltage 11/25/234 KV
Rated power MVA LV1 (31.5/45) LV2 (31.5/45) LVH (31.5/45)
Rated voltage KV 11 
 25 234
Rated current (A) 1653/2362 727/1039 75/107
This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection 
 quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar Al Aresh PS general 
 director.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by 
 accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, 
 quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, 
 clothes, breathing mask, safety glass, safety belt when cleaning insulators.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, 
 clothes, breathing mask, safety glass, safety belt when cleaning insulators.
Transformer isolation proper grounding on all sides.
There is danger 
 of falling from the top of transformer.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, safety shoes, and complete tool
Voltage indicator, portable earth for discharging.
Blower, fiber glass PVC lades, brushes.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Work to be Carried out
Transformer Temperature
Watch and record the oil thermometer and record max. oil temperature readings
Watch and record the coil thermometer and record max. coil temperature
Load Condition and Ambient 
Temperature
Notes: in the daily inspection, check not only that temperature are held 
 within the maximum limit. But also that the temperature lies in sat is factory 
 rang in rotation of their values to the test results
Oil Level
Supervise and record the oil level in main tank conservator
Check the soiled window glass of the oil level gauge
Oil Leakage
Check for oil leaks in connections such as of those valves, meters especially 
 in gasket parts and welded parts
Breather
Pay attention to the discoloration of the absorbent
Notes: the absorbent will turn from blue into pink if its moisture content 
 becomes in excess of 20 or 25% in gravimetric ratio
Pressure Relief Device
Check for marks of blowout, and oil leaks
Cooler Radiators
Check for oil leaks
Check for abnormal rotating sounds (fan cooled type or forced oil cooled 
 type).
On Load Tap Changer
Check whether or not the tap position is correct.
Record the number of tap changing operation. 
 Position 
 no. The number of tap
Check that the oil level shows between the lowest and the high test makes. 
 Low / High
Bushing
If the bushing is provided with oil level gauge, observe oil level and check 
 for oil leaks
Evaluate the extent of the bushing contamination
Indicators
Check for proper function
Return the Transformer into 
Service
Disconnect the grounds on all sides of transformer (220,22,11kv)
Ensure that there is no any tools or fine cloth on the top of the transformer.
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area
Finish the work permit with coordination with shift 
 engineer.
